gizmo.title: Nane hua ʻōlelo keʻa
gizmo.description: He nane hua ʻōlelo keʻa i hana ʻia mai kekahi papa inoa o nā hua ʻōlelo a me nā kuhi. Hana ʻia ka mānoanoa nou; kikokiko nā haumāna i nā hua ʻōlelo a nānā iā lākou.

configure.title: Poʻo inoa
configure.description: Ka poʻo inoa a i ʻole ka nīnau i hōʻike ʻia ma luna o ka nane.

configure.title: Nā hua ʻōlelo
configure.description: Kēlā me kēia hua ʻōlelo a me kona kuhi. Hana ʻia ka mānoanoa mai kēia papa inoa: kau mua ʻia ka hua ʻōlelo lōʻihi loa a keʻa nā mea ʻē aʻe iā ia ma nā hua palapala like.

advanced.title: Nā hoʻāʻo
advanced.description: ʻEhia manawa e hiki ai i kekahi haumāna ke nānā. ʻO ka 0, palena ʻole.

advanced.title: Waihoʻoluʻu koʻikoʻi
advanced.description: Waihoʻoluʻu koho no ka ʻāpana poʻo, ka hua ʻōlelo e hana ʻia nei a me nā pihi hana.

advanced.title: Hiki ke ʻōpiʻi
advanced.description: Hōʻike i kēia nane ma ke ʻano he lālani e wehe a pani ai. Ke wehe ʻia kekahi, pani ʻia nā nīnau ʻōpiʻi ʻē aʻe ma kona ʻaoʻao.

advanced.title: Hoʻomaka me ka ʻōpiʻi
advanced.description: Ke hiki ke ʻōpiʻi, e hoʻomaka ma ke ʻano he lālani pani e hōʻike ana i ka poʻo inoa a me kona kūlana wale nō.

advanced.title: ʻAno kaha helu
advanced.description: OER Schema: ke ʻano kaha helu no kēia loiloi (e laʻa nā ʻai, hua palapala, pakeneka, pau ʻana).

advanced.title: Pahuhopu aʻo
advanced.description: OER Schema: ka pahuhopu aʻo e pili ana i kēia loiloi.

developer.title: Inoa o ka hoʻokolohua
developer.description: Inoa hoʻokolohua i hoʻohana ʻia no ka hōʻike xAPI ma nā ʻōnaehana kālailai.

developer.title: Papa
developer.description: OER Schema: ka papa i manaʻo ʻia ai kēia loiloi.
